initial_generation.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a polished transparent PNG logo for the header of a friendly children's English school.
Input image: the provided Starkids logo is the edit target and identity reference.
Primary request: refine this existing logo into one polished, compact horizontal web logo. Preserve the recognizable playful pastel rainbow, smiling pink star, and multicolored Starkids identity from the reference while improving readability, typography, outlines, alignment and spacing.
Text (verbatim): "Starkids"
Typography: exactly one word, capital S and lowercase tarkids, on one clean horizontal baseline. All seven letters must be distinct and immediately readable. Smooth rounded custom lettering with professional spacing. Preserve a balanced pink, teal, green and lavender palette inspired by the reference. The lettering is the dominant element.
Composition/framing: horizontal approximately 3:1 canvas, ideally 1536x512 pixels. A friendly compact rainbow and smiling pink-star emblem sits beside or lightly above the first letters, without obscuring any lettering. Include at most one or two tiny star accents. Avoid the original stacked two-line word treatment. Full logo remains inside generous transparent padding, with about 8% clear margin on every outer edge.
Finish: cleaner crisp outlines, simple shapes, restrained small details, mature professional polish appropriate to a friendly children's English school. Strong legibility when displayed at roughly 160x60 pixels. Flat clean logo art, no realistic textures.
Background: genuinely transparent background with alpha transparency, including around and inside the logo; NOT a white background and NOT a checkerboard drawing.
Constraints: preserve the original brand identity and cheerful expression. No tagline, other words, mockup, border, watermark, paper sheet, background scene, drop shadow, excessive decorations or fussy tiny details. Deliver only the finished transparent logo.
